summary: Frontend-only retest of 3 fixes on My Dezider Step 10 / ActionItemEditor. All 3 fixes VERIFIED WORKING. (1) 'In CTT' / 'In LifeStyle' ported pill is fully clickable across its whole area and navigates to /tools/ctt and /tools/lifestyle respectively. (2) 'Complete Decision' now shows a confirm dialog ('Complete this decision?' with 'Not yet' / 'Complete'); on Complete it does PUT /api/decisions/{id} with status='completed' (verified via API, decision.status=='completed' and final_choice_decided_at set) and shows a success dialog 'Decision Completed 🎉' with a 'Done' button — no silent no-op anymore. (3) Modal inputs (What / Who / By When / Time / Notes) all carry inline --placeholderTextColor: #9CA3AF and render with empty value='', so example text is a true grey placeholder, not a pre-filled value.
action_items: Minor (non-blocking) follow-up for FIX 2: On a directly-loaded /prr/{id} page, the 'Done' handler does `try { router.back(); } catch { router.replace('/(tabs)') }`. router.back() is a no-op (not a throw) on web when there is no history entry — the catch never fires, so after the success dialog the user remains on the same screen instead of going to tabs. The decision is correctly saved as completed and 'Document Learnings' appears, so this is acceptable, but if you want guaranteed navigation when arriving via a direct URL, use `if (router.canGoBack?.()) router.back(); else router.replace('/(tabs)')`.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded decision id=ed8c35ba-8950-4e9b-a86c-287eafecfdfc (TEST_iter79_chosen_cc2d37) owned by harden_1777921741@example.com which already had chosen_option_id set. Added two TEST_-prefixed action items ('TEST_AutoAction Negotiate with vendor' ported to CTT, 'TEST_LifestyleAction Morning routine' ported to LifeStyle). Decision is now status='completed' as a side-effect of testing the Complete flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: POST /api/auth/login with credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md works directly — no WhatsApp gate triggered for harden_1777921741@example.com in this run. Step 10 of /prr/{id} is reachable by clicking the '10' pill in the top step bar (only when chosen_option_id is set; otherwise GradientButton 'Complete Decision' is hidden). RN-web does NOT render arbitrary scroll on document.body via mouse.wheel — to reach the bottom of a Step 10 view, walk all elements and set .scrollTop = scrollHeight on any with overflowY in (auto|scroll). The cross-platform showAlert() renders multi-button dialogs via <AlertHost />; selectors 'text="Not yet"', 'text="Complete"', 'text="Done"' work directly. Port pills are rendered as TouchableOpacity; the visible bounding box may report a small width (~31px) because RN-web sizes to the text, but the entire pill is the touch target.
rca_of_issue: All 3 fixes verified PASS — no remaining RCA needed. Evidence captured: PUT /api/decisions/{id} request observed via page.on('request'), decision.status='completed' confirmed via GET /api/decisions/{id}, navigation URLs verified to be /tools/ctt and /tools/lifestyle after pill taps, and all 5 modal inputs carry inline --placeholderTextColor:#9CA3AF with empty value attributes.
